title: Smart Analytics: Chinese humanoid robot makers were 97%+ of global shipments in H1 2026, reaching ~19,100 unit shipments globally, up from 5,100 in H1 2025 (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
summary: Saritha Rai / Bloomberg: Smart Analytics: Chinese humanoid robot makers were 97%+ of global shipments in H1 2026, reaching ~19,100 unit shipments globally, up from 5,100 in H1 2025 — China's humanoid robot makers commanded more than 97% of global shipments in the first half of 2026, according to new industry data affirming …
